mapper.sql: t.* , qc_rule.code AS rule_code , qc_rule.name AS rule_name , qc_plan.code AS qc_plan_code , qc_plan.name AS qc_plan_name
FROM mes_qc_task t LEFT JOIN mes_qc_rule qc_rule ON qc_rule.id = t.rule_id AND qc_rule.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_qc_plan qc_plan ON qc_plan.id = t.qc_plan_id AND qc_plan.deleted = 0
